#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstring>
#include <climits>
#include <queue>
using namespace std;

const int A = 26, INF = 0x3f3f3f3f;

class CF884F {
public:
    CF884F() {}
    void solve() {
        int n;
        cin >> n;
        n /= 2;
        n_ = 1 + n + A + 1;
        m_ = n + n * A + A;
        init();
        
        string s;
        cin >> s;
        vector<int> bb(n * 2);
        for (int i = 0; i < n * 2; i++) {
            cin >> bb[i];
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            link_(0, 1 + i, 2, 0);
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            int j = n * 2 - 1 - i;
            int ai = s[i] - 'a';
            int aj = s[j] - 'a';
            for (int a = 0; a < A; a++) {
                int b;
                if (a == ai && a == aj)
                    b = max(bb[i], bb[j]);
                else if (a == ai)
                    b = bb[i];
                else if (a == aj)
                    b = bb[j];
                else
                    b = 0;
                link_(1 + i, 1 + n + a, 1, -b);
            }
        }
        
        vector<int> kk(A, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i < n * 2; i++) {
            int a = s[i] - 'a';
            kk[a]++;
        }
        
        for (int a = 0; a < A; a++) {
            link_(1 + n + a, n_ - 1, kk[a], 0);
        }
        
        cout << -edmonds_karp(0, n_ - 1) << endl;
    }
    
private:
    int n_, m_;
    int __ = 1;
    vector<int> oo, oh;
    
    int link(int o, int h) {
        oo.push_back(o);
        oh.push_back(h);
        return __++;
    }
    
    vector<int> ii, jj, cc, cost, cost_;
    vector<int> ae, pi, dd, ff;
    vector<int> pq, iq;
    int cnt;
    
    void init() {
        oo.assign(1 + m_ * 2, 0);
        oh.assign(1 + m_ * 2, 0);
        ii.assign(m_, 0);
        jj.assign(m_, 0);
        cc.assign(m_ << 1, 0);
        cost.assign(m_, 0);
        cost_.assign(m_, 0);
        pi.assign(n_, INF);
        dd.assign(n_, 0);
        ff.assign(n_, 0);
        ae.assign(n_, 0);
        pq.assign(1 + n_, 0);
        iq.assign(n_, 0);
        m_ = 0;
        __ = 1;
    }
    
    void link_(int i, int j, int c, int co) {
        int h = m_++;
        ii.push_back(i);
        jj.push_back(j);
        cc.push_back(c);
        cc.push_back(0);
        cost.push_back(co);
        cost_.push_back(0);
        ae.push_back(0);
        ae[i] = link(ae[i], h << 1);
        ae.push_back(0);
        ae[j] = link(ae[j], h << 1 | 1);
    }
    
    bool less(int u, int v) {
        return pi[u] < pi[v] || (pi[u] == pi[v] && dd[u] < dd[v]);
    }
    
    int i2(int i) {
        i *= 2;
        if (i > cnt) return 0;
        if (i < cnt && less(pq[i + 1], pq[i])) return i + 1;
        return i;
    }
    
    void pq_up(int u) {
        int i, j, v;
        i = iq[u];
        while ((j = i / 2) > 0 && less(u, v = pq[j])) {
            pq[i] = v;
            iq[v] = i;
            i = j;
        }
        pq[i] = u;
        iq[u] = i;
    }
    
    void pq_dn(int u) {
        int i, j, v;
        i = iq[u];
        while ((j = i2(i)) > 0 && less(v = pq[j], u)) {
            pq[i] = v;
            iq[v] = i;
            i = j;
        }
        pq[i] = u;
        iq[u] = i;
    }
    
    void pq_add_last(int u) {
        pq[++cnt] = u;
        iq[u] = cnt;
    }
    
    int pq_remove_first() {
        int u = pq[1];
        int v = pq[cnt--];
        if (v != u) {
            iq[v] = 1;
            pq_dn(v);
        }
        iq[u] = 0;
        return u;
    }
    
    bool dijkstra(int s, int t) {
        fill(pi.begin(), pi.end(), INF);
        pi[s] = 0;
        cnt = 0;
        pq_add_last(s);
        while (cnt > 0) {
            int i = pq_remove_first();
            int d = dd[i] + 1;
            for (int o = ae[i]; o != 0; o = oo[o]) {
                int h_ = oh[o];
                if (cc[h_] > 0) {
                    int h = h_ >> 1;
                    int j = i ^ ii[h] ^ jj[h];
                    int p = pi[i] + ((h_ & 1) == 0 ? cost_[h] : -cost_[h]);
                    if (pi[j] > p || (pi[j] == p && dd[j] > d)) {
                        if (pi[j] == INF)
                            pq_add_last(j);
                        pi[j] = p;
                        dd[j] = d;
                        ff[j] = h_;
                        pq_up(j);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return pi[t] != INF;
    }
    
    int trace(int s, int t) {
        while (t != s) {
            int h_ = ff[t], h = h_ >> 1;
            cc[h_]--;
            cc[h_ ^ 1]++;
            t ^= ii[h] ^ jj[h];
        }
        return 1;
    }
    
    int edmonds_karp(int s, int t) {
        for (int h = 0; h < m_; h++) {
            int i = ii[h], j = jj[h];
            pi[j] = min(pi[j], pi[i] + cost[h]);
        }
        for (int h = 0; h < m_; h++) {
            int i = ii[h], j = jj[h];
            cost_[h] = cost[h] + pi[i] - pi[j];
        }
        int f = 0;
        while (dijkstra(s, t)) {
            f += trace(s, t);
            for (int h = 0; h < m_; h++) {
                int i = ii[h], j = jj[h];
                if (pi[i] != INF && pi[j] != INF) {
                    cost_[h] += pi[i] - pi[j];
                }
            }
        }
        int ans = 0;
        for (int h = 0; h < m_; h++) {
            ans += cc[h << 1 | 1] * cost[h];
        }
        return ans;
    }
};

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    CF884F solver;
    solver.solve();
    return 0;
}
